_comment: Before/after satellite comparison: the 2022 Indus floods in Sindh. `date` is the before image, `date_end` the after; the satellite_after overlay cross-fades between them on the narration cue.
title: The Water Came

shots._line: 0.0-5.0  In July 2022, the lower Indus looked like this.
5.4-12.0  Then the monsoon arrived... a third of the country under water.
12.0-18.0  Thirty three million people were affected.

beats.text: In July 2022, the lower Indus looked like this.
Six weeks later the monsoon had put a third of the country under water.
Thirty three million people were affected.

narration: In July 2022, the lower Indus looked like this. Six weeks later the monsoon had put a third of the country under water. Thirty three million people were affected.
